name: The Westin Reserva Conchal
positioning: All-inclusive golf and spa resort on 2,400 acres at Playa Conchal on Costa Rica's North Pacific Riviera (officially The Westin Reserva Conchal, an All-Inclusive Golf Resort & Spa)
best_for: Families wanting bunk-bed suites and a family lounge
Golfers who want a Robert Trent Jones II course on site
Travelers who want an all-inclusive beach stay in Guanacaste

facts.text: The resort is set between forests and beaches of the North Pacific Riviera in Costa Rica.
The all-inclusive resort spans 2,400 acres in Guanacaste.
The spa has couples and hydrotherapy rooms and separate saunas for men and women.
Spa treatment rooms have light stone walls and windows with garden views.
Bunk Bed Family rooms have a king bed for parents and a bunk bed for kids.
Manglar serves fresh seafood and house-made salsas in a beachside setting.
La Sabana serves Costa Rican cuisine with traditional recipes and locally sourced ingredients.
The resort has a floodlit tennis court with lessons for adults and children.
A granite swim-up bar sits under a natural palm palapa.
Nearby attractions include the beaches of Tamarindo and Las Baulas National Park.

highlights.text: The free-form, lagoon-style freshwater pool is one of the largest in Central America and has a whirlpool and a kids' pool.
The resort is located on the beaches of Playa Conchal, near Tamarindo.
The 18-hole, par 71 golf course was designed by Robert Trent Jones II, with lakes and ravines.
Westin Club Rooms have a balcony with an outdoor soaking tub.
Spa treatments include Thai massage, reflexology and a signature Shells Massage.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires planned transportation for excursions beyond the property.
WhataHotel notes the large-scale resort may feel expansive for guests who prefer a more intimate boutique experience.
